title: CPCSC Level 1 flaw handling and timely updates need sampled receipts
remediation: The sponsor vulnerability and update owner inventories assessed software and firmware and approves the remediation window. Follow a sampled flaw from identification and reporting through correction. Retain release and installation timestamps, relevant post-update verification, and authorized treatment for any outstanding update. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect the approved update window and a redacted flaw-to-install record with release, deployment and verification dates
